notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two coat-closet leaves and two laundry-closet leaves were counted separately as required. Their individual order and midpoint assignments are less certain because each pair was manipulated rapidly between sampled frames.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entryway and kitchen. The user opens and closes both leaves of a coat closet, both leaves of a laundry closet, a refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
